{{Quote|One that turned out to be run by a Zeltron who was as pretty as a Tellanadan moonflower and as mean as a Hismauli hawk-snake.|Lando Calrissian, on the brewery's operator|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hismauli hawk-snake''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native<ref name="Warfare" /> to the [[Hismaul system/Legends|Hismaul system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> Professional [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] stated that a [[Unidentified Zeltron (Clendor)|Zeltron]], who ran a [[Unidentified brewery|brewery]] owned by Calrissian on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clendor]], was as mean as one of these [[Snake/Legends|snakes]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hismauli hawk-snake was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] as a guide dedicated to the conflicts in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Warfare" />
